import sys
import heapq

def main():
    import sys
    import heapq
    
    def readints():
        return list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    
    data = readints()
    N = data[0]
    A = data[1:]
    
    # Use a min-heap to simulate the process
    heapq.heapify(A)
    
    while len(A) > 1:
        # Pop the two smallest elements
        a = heapq.heappop(A)
        b = heapq.heappop(A)
        
        # The smaller one attacks the larger one
        if a < b:
            heapq.heappush(A, b - a)
        else:
            heapq.heappush(A, a - b)
    
    # The last remaining element is the answer
    print(A[0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
thought_path_snapshot: Simulate the process with a greedy approach: Always let the monster with the highest health attack the monster with the second-highest health until only one monster remains. This might not always yield the minimum but provides a structured way to estimate the outcome.

import sys
import heapq

def main():
    import sys
    import heapq
    
    def read_ints():
        return list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    
    data = read_ints()
    N = data[0]
    A = data[1:]
    
    heapq.heapify(A)
    
    while len(A) > 1:
        x = heapq.heappop(A)
        y = heapq.heappop(A)
        heapq.heappush(A, y - x)
    
    print(A[0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys

def main():
    import sys
    import random

    def min_final_health(N, A):
        # Check if there is any odd health value
        has_odd = any(a % 2 != 0 for a in A)
        
        # If there is an odd health value, the final health can be 1
        if has_odd:
            return 1
        
        # If all health values are even, the final health will be even
        # The minimum even number is 2
        return 2

    # Read input
    N = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    A = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
    
    # Calculate and print the minimum possible final health
    print(min_final_health(N, A))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
